**Indikator 9b** is a clinical quality indicator used within the Danish Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) to evaluate the performance of acute surgical care. Specifically, it measures the 30-day mortality rate among patients who have a [[charlson-comorbiditets-indeks|Charlson Comorbiditets indeks]] score of 1 or 2, indicating a moderate level of comorbidity [^src1]. This metric serves as a supplementary indicator to the broader acute surgery mortality assessments, allowing for risk-adjusted evaluations of hospital and regional performance [^src1].

The data for Indikator 9b covers the specific reporting period from September 1, 2023, to August 31, 2024 [^src1]. During this timeframe, the indicator tracked outcomes across multiple regions and hospitals in Denmark, providing a detailed breakdown of clinical outcomes for this specific patient demographic [^src1].

In the Region of Southern Denmark, [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]] recorded 9 deaths among 45 included patients [^src1]. [[odense-universitetshospital-svendborg|Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg]] reported 15 deaths out of 70 patients [^src1], while [[sygehus-lillebaelt|Sygehus Lillebælt]] and [[sygehus-soenderjylland|Sygehus Sønderjylland]] recorded 4 deaths out of 20 patients and 5 deaths out of 23 patients, respectively [^src1].

In Central Denmark Region, [[midtjylland-region-i-alt|Midtjylland Region i alt]] reported a total of 40 deaths among 152 included patients [^src1]. At the hospital level within this region, [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] recorded 10 deaths out of 37 patients [^src1], [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]] had 7 deaths out of 28 patients [^src1], and [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] reported 11 deaths out of 37 patients [^src1]. Additionally, [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]] and [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]] each recorded 6 deaths out of 25 included patients [^src1].

In the North Denmark Region, [[nordjylland-region-i-alt|Nordjylland Region i alt]] reported 13 deaths among 48 patients [^src1]. Within this region, [[aalborg-universitetshospital|Aalborg Universitetshospital]] recorded 8 deaths out of 32 patients, and [[regionshospital-nordjylland|Regionshospital Nordjylland]] reported 5 deaths out of 16 patients [^src1].
